bad: Someone's temper is shorter than usual, and it is not really about the dishes.
corrected: Someone finally says no to the demand they have agreed to a hundred times before, and the anger comes out with all hundred refusals behind it.
why: Domestic prop symbolized generic conflict; replacement proves accumulated Aries anger and delayed refusal.

bad: The raise conversation that has been avoided for a year finally happens, angry.
corrected: The raise conversation that has been avoided for a year finally happens, and the frustration has years behind it.
why: Compression for cleverness; restore the normal sentence.
rule: FINAL V5 LOCK RULES: do not compress natural prose

bad: Some people will drain a well dry and then blame it for being empty.
corrected: Some people will keep taking support as long as it is available, then resent the person who finally runs out.
why: Reader had to translate the well into a person being depleted; write the ordinary language.

bad: Someone shares the work they kept private because they were afraid of looking full of themselves.
corrected: Someone shares work they kept private because being openly proud of it felt risky.
why: Over-specified psychological motive not earned by observable behavior.

bad: secrets, leverage, debts, favors, and the facts everyone knows but nobody names
corrected: secrets, leverage, private agreements, and the facts everyone knows but nobody names
why: Debts pushed Scorpio toward an 8th-house delineation; sign is not its associated house.

bad: Until {{exitDate}}, the hierarchy gets harder to accept without question. The person doing the boss's job asks for that pay. Someone turns down the promotion that was really just more work in a nicer chair.
corrected: Until {{exitDate}}, the rules get harder to accept without question. The reliable person stops covering for someone else's lack of planning. Someone asks why the same standard changes depending on who broke it. A promotion gets turned down because it comes with more responsibility and no more authority.
why: Capricorn had collapsed into boss/title/career, functioning as the 10th house; broadened to responsibility, standards, legitimacy.

bad: taken out on the person in front of you
corrected: taken out on the person in front of them
why: Isolated second person inside collective third-person sign cores.

bad: Wanting security is not greed. It stops being security when nothing ever counts as enough.
corrected: Wanting something reliable is not greed. Lilith refuses a worth that has to be proved over and over.
why: Bleak diagnosis that closes a door; owner voice keeps agency and points somewhere.

bad: You may move furniture, finally repair or hang what has been waiting, invite people over
corrected: You may move furniture, repair what has been broken, finally hang the art or photos that have been sitting in a box, invite people over
why: Reader had to fill in the object; governor requires the noun.

bad: claim a role you have already been doing
corrected: claim a title for work you have already been doing
why: You do not do a role; you do the work, hold the responsibilities, or perform the role.

bad: making your role in groups more visible and recognition from friends more important than usual
corrected: making your role in groups easier to see and making appreciation from friends matter more than usual
why: Ordinary language over technically correct phrasing; awkward coordination fixed with doubled 'making'.

bad: Someone won't shut up about their truth, louder and louder. Lilith in Sagittarius pushes wounded beliefs into the spotlight, like a shout that refuses to be ignored.
corrected: Someone has decided their belief is the only fact in the room, and disagreement now sounds like ignorance, disloyalty, or bad character. Lilith in Sagittarius brings old fights around truth, belief, freedom, education, morality, and who gets to define what is right back into the open.
why: Simile decoration and harsh determinism replaced by observable behavior demonstrating the mechanism.

bad: A teacher, institution, publication, or public voice gets challenged over the version of the truth it has been presenting as settled.
corrected: A claim that everyone has been repeating as fact gets challenged when somebody checks what it is actually based on.
why: House bleed survived good prose: teacher/education/publication/institution cluster defined Sagittarius through the 9th-house inventory instead of belief-and-conviction behavior. Judge by nouns, not by how natural the paragraph sounds.

bad: Honesty shows whether the connection can stay warm once your answer has equal weight.
corrected: [cut; end the paragraph on the concrete consequence]
why: a connection staying easy is weird
rule: COLD RENDERED PROSE RULE / NO-VAGUENESS GOVERNOR
